description: Syncs an app's pre with a folder of the developer's GitHub repo. "link" (owner only) makes the first sync; every sync also DELETES pre's files missing from the folder. "sync" pulls now; "commit" writes files to their repo in one commit; "unlink" (owner only); "example" re-publishes pro's code to their public examples repo (apps marked as example). Neblla runs no build: commit the build output. While linked, each file tool call is a commit on their branch: agree it first. Users get changes only via neblla_promote "save" env "pro", which also writes pro's branch. More: neblla_get_llms tools/git

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

branch.description: link: pre's branch (default: the repo's default).

confirm.description: unlink: true runs it; without it nothing changes.

deletes.description: commit: paths to delete in the same commit.

files.description: commit: the files to write, [{ path, content }], in one commit.

proBranch.description: link: pro's branch, written only by neblla_promote (default "neblla-pro").

replace.description: link: accept that the first sync deletes pre's files the folder lacks (else error would_delete_files).

subdir.description: link: the folder of the repo that holds the app (default the root).

syncMode.description: link / set_mode: "auto" (default, a push syncs) or "manual".

token.description: link: a GitHub token, only if the developer has not signed in with GitHub.

name: neblla_git
title: Link and sync with GitHub
